data.name: Haedong Bisa: Secret Records of the East
data.detailed_description:
The land burns. Whose fate must fall beneath the blade?

In 1597, the flames of the Jeongyu War sweep across the mountains and rivers of Joseon once more. Haedong Bisa favors storytelling over spectacle — a martial arts narrative RPG built around the tale itself.

There is no rest on this journey. Haedong Bisa portrays the horrors of war and human cruelty without embellishment. A ruthless avenger one moment, a righteous savior the next — you will prove for yourself what honor (俠) still means when nothing is left standing.

One man's journey begins in Hampyeong, passes through Naju, and ends at the walls of Hanyang. History has already set the stage; you decide who he becomes upon it. Every decision you make reshapes both the fate of Joseon and his ending.

  • Where Comic Style Meets Ink Wash: The raw breath of 16th-century Joseon, rendered in a distinctive art style where comic-inspired staging and the aesthetics of ink strokes become one. Experience moments as vivid and dramatic as reading through a martial arts comic.

  • A History You Write: The heart of this game is its story. Countless branches and endings await, each shaped entirely by the choices you make.

  • A World Grounded in History: Real locations and figures — from Naju and Hampyeong to Hanyang — give weight to every step of your journey.

Fate in the Midst of War: Where Will Your Secret History Lead?

Joseon in flames, a life etched in ink strokes.

Free equipment customization and choices with real weight await — complete a story only you could tell.

Where will your story come to rest?

data.short_description: On a land in flames, whose fate will fall? Set in 1597, you are a warrior caught between invaders and court intrigue. Your choices decide your path—be a blade that saves lives, or walk a road of ruin. A Joseon martial arts narrative RPG.
data.supported_languages:
English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1 / 10 / 11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4340 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL-compatible / VRAM 2GB+
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64bit)

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL-compatible / VRAM 4GB+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
